Alyeska Investment Group LP Has Decreased Mohawk Inds (MHK) Holding by $55.95 Million as Stock Value Declined; Wills Financial Group Stake in Apple (AAPL) Decreased by $304,441
June 27, 2018 - By Maria Brooks
Anand Parekh decreased its stake in Mohawk Inds Inc (MHK) by 44.49% based on its latest 2018Q1 regulatory filing with the SEC. Alyeska Investment Group Lp sold 241,174 shares as the company’s stock declined 14.84% with the market. The hedge fund run by Anand Parekh held 300,868 shares of the consumer durables company at the end of 2018Q1, valued at $69.87 million, down from 542,042 at the end of the previous reported quarter. Alyeska Investment Group Lp who had been investing in Mohawk Inds Inc for a number of months, seems to be less bullish one the $15.76B market cap company. The stock decreased 1.08% or $2.3 during the last trading session, reaching $211.2. About 421,501 shares traded. Mohawk Industries, Inc. (NYSE:MHK) has declined 9.97% since June 27, 2017 and is downtrending. It has underperformed by 22.54% the S&P500.
